subject: Sensitivity Analysis of Dynamic Occupancy Models

messages.author: 98b567f75758dc3a
messages.subject: Sensitivity Analysis of Dynamic Occupancy Models
parts:
Dear All,

I am considering an analysis of different occupancy model structures for a single species by way of changing the capped maximum number of secondary surveys, at each site, in a season (50 vs 140) as well as changing the sites studied from those surveyed at least once (all) during the study period, to those sites which are surveyed every year in the study period (Common).

I was wondering if there is a relatively simple way to conduct a sensitivity analysis of different models structures used in DOMs through something like the Area Under the Curve.

I know that blockCV is a useful package for Species Distribution Models evaluation by way of AUC and ROC, but I've only seen it used with Raster objects, for which my data is not in that form. 

Would a sensitivity analysis be adequate if I just looked at how the estimates change when the structure changes, or should I aim to include something like AUC?

Thanks
James
